answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Reaching the vertex of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Work waits on the mirror until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the hollow of the next round.
